name: chs-hub
description: Columbus Home Solutions operational hub — Cloudflare Worker backend + static docs

scripts.ops:dlq:list: wrangler d1 execute chs-hub-db --remote --command "SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, attempts, last_attempt_status, error_message, first_seen_at, last_seen_at FROM sync_dead_letters WHERE resolved_at IS NULL ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.ops:dlq:resolved: wrangler d1 execute chs-hub-db --remote --command "SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, attempts, resolved_at FROM sync_dead_letters WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY resolved_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.ops:sync:log: wrangler d1 execute chs-hub-db --remote --command "SELECT id, job_name, status, started_at, finished_at, rows_affected, duration_ms, error_message FROM sync_log ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 20"
